lead.headline: Jacobs is still in your lineup — start Gordon
lead.deck: Finger surgery, up to three weeks. Moving Gordon in is the whole 15.8-point gap; no claim is worth priority tonight.
lead.body: The bad news first: Josh Jacobs had finger surgery and is out up to three weeks, and he is still in the RB slot at 0.0 — the third brief today to say it. Ollie Gordon II (15.8) replaces him; Marks (14.0) is a coin flip behind and stays on the bench. Gordon now runs behind Kyle McCord with Willis on IR. Mahomes' elbow is day-to-day but expected to play, which is Rice's week. On the wire, nothing clears IPADE's never-resetting priority: Kaleb Johnson is a handcuff to your own injured back, and DeMario Douglas is worth adding only as a free agent after 02:00, and only if Wilson or Pickens is ruled out.
